The '''Ret''' were sapient reptilians, indigenous to [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Gelefil]].<ref name="CSWE1" /> They had heavy-lidded eyes and scales which changed colors with their emotions. They were also long-lived with the average lifespan of hundreds of years.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|I|32|Annoo-dat}}</ref>

When the [[Annoo-dat Prime|Annoo-dat]] conquered their home planet, its name was changed to Annoo after the [[Annoo (original)|original homeworld]] of the Annoo-dat Prime. After a century of Annoo-dat rule, the Rets came to call themselves [[Annoo-dat]] and the two cultures largely merged with the [[Dat-an]] language replacing [[Tra'ang'a]] as the most common language on the planet. To distinguish between the two species, [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] called the Ret '''Annoo-dat Blue''' and the original Annoo-dat [[Annoo-dat Prime]]. Neither species made such distinctions.

The notorious crime syndicate, the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]], was based on Annoo and was for the most part composed of Annoo-dat Blue.
